title: From Solvers to Research: Large Language Model-Driven Formal Mathematics at the Research Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2607.07779v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models have made rapid progress in generating machine-checked proofs for well-defined mathematical problems. Extending this progress to research mathematics requires more than solving isolated theorems. Research involves choosing questions, developing definitions and conjectures, connecting results, and combining formal proofs with expert judgment. This survey examines how LLM-driven systems can support these broader activities. We review formal-mathematics tasks, datasets, and autoformalization, and organize proof-generation methods into three overlapping areas: training strategies, inference-time search and adaptation, and agentic workflows. We then examine benchmark results, selected research projects, and platforms for collaborative mathematical work. A central distinction runs throughout the survey: checking a formal proof does not by itself establish that it captures the intended problem or makes a new math

translated_title: 从求解器到研究：大型语言模型驱动的研究前沿形式化数学
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在为明确定义的数学问题生成机器可检验的证明方面取得了快速进展。然而，将这一进展扩展到研究层面的数学，需要的不仅仅是解决孤立的定理。研究工作涉及选择问题、发展定义与猜想、连接不同结果，以及将形式化证明与专家判断相结合。本综述考察了LLM驱动的系统如何支持这些更广泛的活动。我们回顾了形式化数学的任务、数据集和自动形式化，并将证明生成方法归纳为三个相互重叠的领域：训练策略、推理时搜索与适应、以及智能体工作流。随后，我们考察了基准测试结果、若干代表性研究项目以及支持协作数学研究的平台。贯穿全文的一个核心区分是：通过形式化证明的机器检验本身，并不能证明该证明真正捕捉了所要研究的数学问题，也无法等同于做出了新的数学贡献。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了LLM驱动的形式化数学进展（涵盖训练策略、推理时搜索与智能体工作流三大方向），并强调从求解明确定义的问题迈向真正的数学研究，关键在于形式化证明之外还需捕捉问题的本意并融入专家判断。
en_tdlr: This survey organizes LLM-driven formal mathematics into training strategies, inference-time search, and agentic workflows, arguing that advancing from solving well-defined problems to research mathematics requires more than machine-checked proofs—capturing the intended question and integrating expert judgment are essential.
